definitions.explanation: Objects used on stage or in film to support the performance. Includes items that actors handle or interact with during a scene.
Small handy tools or accessories used for a specific purpose.

notes:
USAGE:
The theatrical sense (sense 1) is the most common usage. In stage and film production, {小道具|こどうぐ} refers to hand props and smaller set items, as opposed to ⟦{大道具|おおどうぐ}→大道具：16301_oodougu⟧ (large set pieces like furniture, walls, and backdrops).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小道具|こどうぐ}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: props manager
- {小道具|こどうぐ}{係|がかり}: person in charge of props
- {小道具|こどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare props
